import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] Comb = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] A = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] B = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] CC = new long[62][62];
    static int R, C, n;
    static String p;
    static long TT, MM, Res;
    static List<Pair>[][] P, Q;
    
    static class Pair {
        long first, second;
        Pair(long f, long s) { first = f; second = s; }
    }
    
    static void Put(int x, int y, long g, long c1, long c2, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            P[x][ck].add(new Pair(g, c1));
            if (c2 != 0) Q[x][ck].add(new Pair(g, c2));
            return;
        }
        // move right (x+1, y)
        if (x + 1 <= n) {
            long nc1 = c1;
            long nc2 = (p.charAt(x + y) != 'B') ? c2 : 0;
            Put(x + 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x + 1][y] : 0), nc1, nc2, ck);
        }
        // move up (x, y+1)
        if (y + 1 <= n) {
            long nc1 = c1;
            long nc2 = (p.charAt(x + y) != 'A') ? c2 : 0;
            Put(x, y + 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y + 1] : 0), nc1, nc2, ck);
        }
    }
    
    static void Calc1(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            if (P[x][ck].isEmpty()) return;
            int t = lowerBound(P[x][ck], (TT + 1) / 2 - g);
            if (t < P[x][ck].size() && P[x][ck].get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (P[x][ck].get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            if (t > 0 && P[x][ck].get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (P[x][ck].get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            return;
        }
        // move left (x-1, y)
        if (x - 1 >= 0) {
            Calc1(x - 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        }
        // move down (x, y-1)
        if (y - 1 >= 0) {
            Calc1(x, y - 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
        }
    }
    
    static void Calc2(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            int t = lowerBound(Q[x][ck], (TT + 1) / 2 - g);
            if (t < Q[x][ck].size() && Q[x][ck].get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (Q[x][ck].get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) {
                    Res += Q[x][ck].get(t).second;
                }
            }
            if (t > 0 && Q[x][ck].get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (Q[x][ck].get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) {
                    Res += Q[x][ck].get(t - 1).second;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (p.charAt(x + y - 1) != 'B') {
            Calc2(x - 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        }
        if (p.charAt(x + y - 1) != 'A') {
            Calc2(x, y - 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
        }
    }
    
    static int lowerBound(List<Pair> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).first >= key) hi = mid;
            else lo = mid + 1;
        }
        return lo;
    }
    
    static void Make(List<Pair> list) {
        if (list.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(list, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a.first, b.first));
        int cnt = 0;
        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
            sum += list.get(i).second;
            if (i == list.size() - 1 || list.get(i).first != list.get(i + 1).first) {
                list.get(cnt).first = list.get(i).first;
                list.get(cnt).second = sum;
                cnt++;
                sum = 0;
            }
        }
        // truncate list to first cnt elements
        while (list.size() > cnt) list.remove(list.size() - 1);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.next();
        n = R + C;
        
        // precompute binomial coefficients up to 60
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            Comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Comb[i][j] = Comb[i - 1][j - 1] + Comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        
        // compute TT = C(2n, 2R)
        TT = Comb[2 * n][2 * R];
        
        // compute arrays A and B
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    A[i][j] = Comb[i - 1][R - 1] * (Comb[2 * n - i][R] - Comb[j][R]);
                }
                if (j > 0) {
                    B[i][j] = Comb[j - 1][R - 1] * (Comb[2 * n - j][R] - Comb[i][R]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // compute CC (number of paths)
        CC[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i != n && p.charAt(i + j) != 'B') {
                    CC[i + 1][j] += CC[i][j];
                }
                if (j != n && p.charAt(i + j) != 'A') {
                    CC[i][j + 1] += CC[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        
        // initialize lists P and Q
        P = new ArrayList[n + 1][2];
        Q = new ArrayList[n + 1][2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                P[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                Q[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        // start Put
        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            if (p.charAt(i + R - 1) != 'B') {
                Put(R, i, A[R][i], Comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[R - 1][i], 0);
            }
            if (p.charAt(i + R - 1) != 'A') {
                Put(i, R, B[i][R], Comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[i][R - 1], 1);
            }
        }
        
        // Make (aggregate) lists
        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                Make(P[i][j]);
                Make(Q[i][j]);
            }
        }
        
        MM = TT + 1;
        Res = 0;
        Calc1(n, n, 0, 0);
        Calc1(n, n, 0, 1);
        Calc2(n, n, 0, 0);
        Calc2(n, n, 0, 1);
        
        System.out.println(Res);
    }
}
